jobs.title: E-Commerce & Content Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Starte bei Symporo durch und unterstütze uns dabei, Daten in aussagekräftige Reports und Dashboards zu verwandeln. Worum es geht Die Symporo Gruppe vereint 13 regionale Catering-Marken mit über 1.400 Mitarbeitenden an acht Standorten. Jede Marke hat ihre eigene Webseite, eigene Kanäle und eigene Kunden: Eltern, Kitas, Schulen, Senioren und Unternehmen. Über unsere Webseiten und Webshops bestellen diese Kunden ihre Mahlzeiten. Gleichzeitig führen wir Schritt für Schritt neue Webseiten und Webshops auf einer gemeinsamen Plattform ein. Wir suchen eine Person, die sich darum kümmert, dass diese Webseiten gut funktionieren, gute Inhalte haben und Bestellungen bringen. Und die Probleme selbst löst, statt auf andere zu warten. Deine Aufgaben Du kümmerst dich darum, wie unsere Webseiten und Webshops funktionieren: Inhalte, Texte, Speisepläne, Stellenanzeigen und Neuigkeiten für die Gruppe und unsere Marken. Vor jedem Start einer neuen Webseite oder eines Webshops prüfst du alles: Du liest Texte Korrektur, testest Bestellungen und Formulare, prüfst Weiterleitungen und meldest Fehler an das Entwicklungsteam. Du behältst im Blick, wie unsere Seiten laufen: Bestellungen, Conversion und wo Kunden abspringen. Du berichtest, was du siehst, und schlägst Verbesserungen vor. Du schreibst Inhalte, die Bestellungen und Anfragen bringen, für unsere Webseiten, LinkedIn und andere Kanäle. Du betreust die LinkedIn-Seite von Symporo. Du hilfst uns, Online-Marketing bei den Marken aufzubauen, die heute noch keines haben. Dabei baust du auf dem auf, was in einem unserer Unternehmen schon funktioniert. Du richtest Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager und die Cookie-Einwilligung (zum Beispiel Cookiebot) ein und hältst sie aktuell. Du kümmerst dich um die Grundlagen der Suchmaschinenoptimierung (SEO) und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Marken auch in den Antworten von KI-Assistenten wie ChatGPT und Claude erscheinen (Generative Engine Optimization, GEO). jobs.title: Junior Video Editor & Camera Operator
jobs.description: About Tessl AI is transforming how software is built, and at Tessl, we're building the infrastructure for what comes next. We're developing a platform that enables engineering teams to build and run AI-powered software factories, where coding agents take on real development work, from picking up engineering tickets to implementing changes and creating pull requests. By combining structured context, reusable agent skills, automated workflows and evaluations, we're making AI-powered development more reliable, repeatable and scalable, while keeping humans in control. We're tackling some of the biggest challenges in autonomous software development, from code quality and security to helping organisations confidently adopt AI agents at scale. Founded by Guy Podjarny, previously founder of Snyk, Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup backed by over $100 million in funding from investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV and Boldstart. Joining Tessl means helping define an entirely new category of technology, solving ambitious technical challenges and shaping the future of software development. About the role We're hiring a junior video editor and camera operator to help make everything Tessl puts on camera: The AI Native Dev podcast, product videos, webinars, livestreams and our AI DevCon conferences. You'll work hand in hand with our video producer (Tom Dowler) in the Marketing team, shooting alongside him and owning a growing share of the edit and publishing. This is an entry-level role. We care more about curiosity, drive and a willingness to pitch in than a polished portfolio, but you'll need to show you can already shoot and cut a decent piece of video. What you'll do Shoot. Assist on every shoot: podcast recordings, product videos, webinars, livestreams and full conference days. Rig cameras, lights and audio, operate a camera, and manage media on set. Cut the podcast. jobs.title: Content Reviewer - United States
jobs.description: Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust. In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information. Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models Qualifications to succeed in this project: Professional fluency in English Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher) Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven prof

jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.description: Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics. The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour). Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know): Health & beauty Fitness Home Decor Fashion Sports Do it yourself Finance Legal Medical Family/Parenting Relationships Real Estate Restaurants Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.) These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover. Requirements : We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff Note : Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.

This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.
